summary.text: Brian Bergkamp is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 93 who has served since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He has a background in accounting and has worked with Koch Industries.

paragraphs.text: Brian Bergkamp graduated from Pretty Prairie High School and earned a degree in accounting from Friends University in 2008.
His career experience includes working with Koch Industries, and he has volunteered with Big Brothers Big Sisters.
Bergkamp assumed office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding J.C. Moore.
Eli Rueda-Vega is the Democratic candidate for the seat in the November 2026 general election.
